capability: Evidence / Mastery Uncertainty + Retention / Transfer / Independence Expansion
runtime_rule: These cases define future executable obligations only. They are not PASS claims and must be executed after the rebuild constitution is reconciled and the exact implementation slice is materialized.

cases.obligation: Learning remains the sole mastery/evidence interpretation writer for the existing S05 semantic families.
Curriculum skill and criterion definitions cannot be mutated by mastery interpretation.
Generic evidence storage/provenance cannot decide Learning admissibility or mastery.
AI tutor output cannot directly write mastery, retention, transfer or independence standing.
Learner Model remains projection-only and cannot manufacture mastery evidence.
Assessment score alone cannot become mastery.
Practice completion/correctness alone cannot become mastery.
Confidence/self-report alone cannot become mastery.
Generic job/runtime success cannot become educational evidence.
No second mastery semantic object family or writer is created by 001G.
Every authoritative mastery projection exposes evidence coverage for the active profile.
Required criteria with no evidence remain visibly missing.
Missing required gate cannot be averaged away by high performance elsewhere.
Insufficient evidence remains explicit and cannot be silently converted to a numeric mastery value.
Unknown evidence standing remains UNKNOWN rather than zero/failure.
Stale evidence is identified explicitly and cannot silently count as fresh.
Contradictory evidence remains visible in projection/explanation.
Model/scorer confidence cannot substitute for evidence coverage.
Evidence source/provenance uncertainty is preserved where relevant to interpretation.
Assistance-condition uncertainty is preserved when it affects the intended claim.
Mastery explanation identifies what additional evidence could strengthen or change the standing.
No universal percentage threshold is used when the active profile does not define it.
Time passage alone cannot create RETAINED standing.
Retention standing requires delayed owner-valid evidence when the profile requires retention.
Delayed evidence binds the exact prior capability/criterion context being revalidated.
Delayed evidence preserves exact assistance/performance conditions relevant to interpretation.
Retention evidence outside the valid policy window is marked stale/inapplicable rather than silently accepted.
No universal delay interval is treated as scientifically optimal for every skill.
Missing retention horizon leaves retention unknown/due or uses an explicitly labeled policy default.
A learner may be currently demonstrated while retention remains not yet checked.
Weak delayed performance changes current interpretation without deleting historical demonstration evidence.
Retention reprojection is deterministic for identical admitted delayed evidence and policy versions.
Retention explanation cites delayed evidence and its as-of/freshness standing.
Immediate repeated success cannot masquerade as delayed retention.
Same-item repetition alone cannot satisfy a transfer gate.
Minor cosmetic item changes do not automatically count as meaningful novelty.
Transfer evidence is evaluated against profile-defined novelty dimensions appropriate to the construct.
Transfer evidence preserves exact target criterion/skill and source task context.
Near-transfer standing cannot be silently promoted to broader/farther transfer when the profile distinguishes them.
A different item identifier alone cannot establish transfer.
Tutor/model recognition of the correct concept is not learner transfer evidence.
Generated answer quality is not learner transfer evidence unless the learner performance itself is validly observed.
One novel success cannot claim broad generalization unless the active profile permits it.
Transfer explanation identifies the novelty dimension and evidence supporting the claim.
Missing transfer evidence remains explicitly unproven when transfer is a required gate.
Transfer reprojection preserves contradictory or weak generalization evidence rather than averaging it away.
Evidence whose meaning depends on support preserves the relevant assistance condition.
AI-assisted success is not automatically independent performance.
Instructionally scaffolded success is not automatically independent performance.
Authorized accommodation is not automatically treated as disallowed assistance.
Permitted tools do not automatically invalidate independent standing.
Unknown assistance standing cannot silently become independent.
Independent-performance gate is required only when the intended construct/profile requires independence.
AI/tool-assisted skills can define tool use as part of legitimate performance conditions.
Support-withdrawal verification creates new evidence and never rewrites prior assisted evidence.
Required accommodation is never withdrawn merely to manufacture an independence check.
Failure under reduced support does not erase prior assisted learning history.
Independence explanation states what assistance was allowed, disallowed, used or unknown.
Contradictory immediate, delayed, transfer or independence evidence remains historically addressable.
A correction to assistance/context classification preserves prior value and correction lineage.
Duplicate same semantic reprojection operation replays the same result.
Conflicting reuse of semantic operation identity fails deterministically.
Lost response after commit reconciles the committed projection instead of creating a duplicate successor.
Restart reconstructs current mastery/retention/transfer/independence standing from durable state.
Evidence count does not treat duplicated underlying source material as independent evidence diversity.
Same-template or same-source variants can be recognized as correlated evidence when the profile requires diversity.
Learner Model can display 001G standing only by citing exact owner-valid evidence/mastery projections.
AI Tutor may consume 001G standing but cannot write or self-certify it.
Adaptive policy cannot turn missing retention/transfer/independence evidence into mastery to preserve progression.
Software PASS cannot be labeled proof of psychometric validity or educational effectiveness.
Changed executable bytes require fresh exact-subject qualification; historical PASS does not transfer.
Cumulative regression preserves prior Learning/Curriculum ownership fences and introduces no Book/Documents/Programming semantic authority.
